module: "Playbook Utils" tab of the mission editor. It offers buttons that add missionAttempt instructions for the current mission to editor_missionPlaybook.book.instructions, with different star combinations (all, default, bonus, random, one by one). The module returns a constructor: require(...)(missionEditor).
notes: Each instruction has the form {type = 'missionAttempt', missionId = id, stars = {key = true}}.
Uses the mission instance's careerSetup._activeStarCache (sortedStars, defaultStarKeysSorted, bonusStarKeysSorted).
"Add Random Single Star" only adds a star if there is more than one star; otherwise the instruction is added with empty stars.

C.desc: Instance of the tab. Fields: missionEditor, tabName = 'Playbook Utils', mission, missionInstance.

init.desc: Constructor: remembers missionEditor and the tab name.

setMission.desc: Sets the current mission and its game instance.

draw.desc: Draws the buttons for adding instructions to the playbook (empty, all stars, default stars, bonus, one random star, random stars, progressive individual addition, bonus in random order).
